evidence.purpose: Find highest seller totals in UZS for the date, both all records and excluding cancellations
evidence.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT seller_inn, seller_name, round(sum(amount_uzs),2) AS total, round(coalesce(sum(amount_uzs) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'),0),2) AS noncancelled FROM v_deals WHERE deal_date >= DATE '2022-01-03' AND deal_date < DATE '2022-01-04' GROUP BY seller_inn,seller_name), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC, seller_inn) AS r_all, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY noncancelled DESC, seller_inn) AS r_non FROM s) SELECT seller_name,total,noncancelled,r_all,r_non FROM ranked WHERE r_all=1 OR r_non=1 LIMIT 2
